question: In 1539, the Battle of Chausa was fought between Humayun and _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sher Shah Suri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Battle of Chausa was fought on June 26, 1539, between the Mughal Emperor Humayun and Sher Shah Suri, the founder of the Suri Empire.
 
• Sher Shah Suri defeated Humayun in this battle, leading to the establishment of the Suri Empire in North India.
 
• The defeat forced Humayun to flee from India, and Sher Shah Suri became the ruler of Delhi.
 
• Sher Shah Suri's victory at Chausa was a significant moment in Indian history, marking the rise of the Suri Empire and the temporary setback of the Mughal Empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Humayun:**

 
 
• Humayun was the second Mughal Emperor who ruled over the Indian subcontinent.
 
• He was the son of Babur, the founder of the Mughal Empire.
 
• Humayun's reign was interrupted by Sher Shah Suri, but he later regained the throne with the help of the Safavid Empire.
 
 
 
• **Sher Shah Suri:**
 
 
• Sher Shah Suri, originally named Farid Khan, was the founder of the Suri Empire in North India.
 
• He is known for his administrative reforms, including the introduction of the "Rupiya" and the improvement of the road network in India.
 
• Sher Shah's rule is considered a model of efficient governance and military strategy.
 
 
 
• **Battle of Chausa:**
 
 
• The Battle of Chausa took place near the town of Chausa, located in present-day Bihar, India.
 
• It was one of the significant battles that showcased the military prowess of Sher Shah Suri.
 
• This battle was crucial in the rise of Sher Shah Suri and the establishment of the Suri Dynasty.
